title.narrative: PDO Indicator 1. Increase in percentage of teachers meeting minimum expectations in EGR lesson delivery

comment.narrative: Minimum expectations defined as teacher actively teaching a lesson or providing learning activity using EGR teacher guides/student textbooks during at least 2 of 3 randomly selected time points during 30-minute literacy lesson using the harmonized observation tool and classroom visits under DLI3. Baseline to be established in first year of Program.

title.narrative: PDO Indicator 2. Percentage of beneficiaries improving by at least one proficiency band in English literacy in the NAPE Assessments

comment.narrative: NAPE has four levels of proficiency in English literacy. This indicator captures the percentage of beneficiaries in the endline cohort in 2027 who improve at least one proficiency band with respect to the percentage in baseline in year 2024. It encompasses EGR districts under the Program.
